summary.oneLiner: An integrated mining operator providing overburden removal, coal extraction and coal logistics as a one-stop coal mining and logistics services provider.
summary.business: Caliber is a mining operator that manages overburden removal, coal extraction and coal logistics together as an integrated services provider, offering end-to-end services including coal extraction, overburden removal, coal loading/unloading, road transportation and rail coordination. It provides contractual coal extraction and overburden removal at open cast mines it does not own, primarily for Coal India subsidiaries WCL and NCL, and runs a logistics business for coal and iron ore. Operations are located in Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.

currentContext.expansion: Caliber has been expanding capacity through large investment in vehicles, plant and machinery, increasing overburden removal by 88.18% from Fiscal 2024 to Fiscal 2026. As of April 30, 2026 it owned 1,811 and leased 100 vehicles, plant and machinery (including 883 mining tippers, 362 tip trailers, 162 excavators, 64 loaders, 65 bulldozers and 32 graders). Net proceeds of the Offer are proposed to fund further capital expenditure for the purchase of commercial vehicles, plant and machinery.
